[[Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow|Mortimer]] (husband) }} '''Elena Ravenwood''' is the daughter of [[Lord Darius Ravenwood]] and the wife of one of the Regent-Lords of [[Gilneas]], [[Regent-Lord Mortimer Harlow|Mortimer Harlow]]. Her hand was given in marriage to Lord Mortimer as part of the treaty that brought an end to the First Rebellion; Elena having sacrificed herself to buy her father time in a tenuous truce.[[The Raven's Sentence and the First Rebellion]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ravenwood, Elena}} [[Category:Human characters]] [[Category:Gilneas (kingdom)]]
